video.desc:
Male beast Felix saves tyrant Kane and is forced into a one-year mate contract. Amid conspiracies and misunderstandings, he chases his dream of becoming a healer—and discovers Kane has secretly loved him for five years.

雄性兽人 Felix 救下了暴君 Kane，却被迫签下为期一年的伴侣契约。在重重阴谋与误会之中，他执着追逐着成为治愈师的梦想，却意外发现，Kane 竟已暗恋了他整整五年。
